prompt: I want to use StackOne's JobAdder MCP with my AI agent. Should I build the agent first and then connect StackOne, or the other way round? And what do I need to set up on the JobAdder side?
skill_note: Connecting an agent over MCP is agents territory; the JobAdder setup half belongs to stackone-connectors. Either may fire; the outcome is what counts.

fetch.name: fetches-jobadder-docs
fetch.note: The JobAdder connector page or its OAuth connector-profile guide.

fetch.name: fetches-mcp-docs
fetch.note: An MCP page, or the older quickstart path that redirects.

reply.name: mentions-oauth
reply.note: JobAdder connects through an OAuth 2.0 connector profile.

reference: Set up StackOne and link the JobAdder account first, then connect the agent to StackOne over MCP; the agent does not need to exist first.
JobAdder uses OAuth 2.0: register an application in the JobAdder Developer Portal with StackOne's redirect URI and put its Client ID and Client Secret in a JobAdder connector profile.
Once the account is linked, the agent reaches JobAdder's actions through the StackOne MCP server or the Agent SDK.
